headline: Sensex, Nifty slip as profit-taking cools pre-Diwali rally while IT stocks lead declines

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Profit-taking set in after a strong pre-Diwali explosive market rally.
Major drag from IT sector companies pulled down benchmark equity indices.
Key heavyweights including HCL Tech, Infosys, and Tata Steel faced selling pressure.
Profit-booking capped recent market gains despite an initial opening in the green.
whatHappening: Nifty traded near 24,900 level while Nifty Bank gained 1% to offer support.
Sensex slipped over 150 points after briefly opening in positive territory.
Market participants monitored global cues including US Nonfarm Payrolls, crude oil prices, and GIFT Nifty.
In domestic developments, Kerala put ethanol blending content in petrol under the scanner.
summary: Indian benchmark indices Sensex and Nifty slipped lower as profit-booking interrupted the pre-Diwali rally. IT stocks such as Infosys and HCL Tech along with Tata Steel were major drags on the market. However, Nifty Bank showed resilience with a 1% gain while Sensex recovered off its lower levels.
